This sample measures how well recognition copes when the foreground and background are close in brightness. dense_or_dark.png: Release notes This build focuses on stability and correctness. We fixed a crash that happened when opening a document from a network volume that disconnected in the middle of a read. Scrolling in long lists is smoother on older hardware, and the export dialog now remembers the last folder you used. Several rare memory leaks were closed Keyboard shortcuts work again in the preview window Large paste operations no longer freeze the editor Localization was refreshed for twelve languages As always, thank you for the detailed bug reports. They make a real difference and most of the fixes above came directly from them.
